resources.title: System Design Interview Cheat Sheet
resources.description: A one-page rehearsal sheet for the four-step whiteboarding structure from Lesson 24 (clarify, estimate, propose, discuss trade-offs), plus a compressed table recapping the architecture and reasoning behind all four case studies from Lessons 20-23.

resources.title: DP-700 4-Week Study Plan Template
resources.description: A fillable version of Lesson 38's 4-week review schedule (with a wrong-answer log) plus Lesson 39's exam-day time budget and flag-and-return rules — turn it into your own dated plan instead of starting from a blank page.

resources.title: Data Catalog Chunk & RAG Trace Reference
resources.description: A compiled reference for the RAG pipeline from Lessons 50-52: the exact chunk shape and index-entry shape to use for catalog metadata, plus the full embed-retrieve-generate trace worked through on a real question, as a pattern to match a new one against.

resources.title: Capstone Retrospective Template
resources.description: The three-question retrospective format used after every capstone project in this course (what worked, what you'd change, what breaks first at 10x scale) as a fillable template, with the filled Project 1 and Project 3 examples it's drawn from.

resources.title: Idempotent MERGE Pattern Reference
resources.description: Three annotated, reusable MERGE patterns pulled directly from the capstone projects — idempotent bronze landing, idempotent scoring/alerting, and SCD Type 2 — with guidance on when a keyed MERGE is required instead of a plain INSERT.
